entities.name: man at the railing with his face to the viewer
entities.what: Man in a dark cap at the front of the railing crowd over the arch, his round face turned toward the viewer; he leans on the near railing and looks down at the big boat under the bridge.
entities.support: bridge deck: 150 px west of the near edge
entities.vis: part: body below the chest hidden by the railing and the men around him
entities.note: On the deck at the railing. On the t7|t8 boundary (face centre u 19347, body 19330-19370): t7 may have recorded him too; keep one. Foot est under the body, just behind the railing's foot (deck's near edge ~v 300 here). Face 19335-19358, v 220-235.

entities.name: man in a hat with a stick over his shoulder, second row
entities.what: Man in a hat standing in the second row behind the railing crowd, a short stick or pole rising at a slant above his right shoulder; only his head and shoulders show between the men in front.
entities.support: bridge deck: 200 px west of the near edge
entities.vis: part: below the shoulders hidden by the crowd and the railing
entities.note: Mid-deck, one row behind the railing. Head 19343-19358, v 189-205; stick 19353-19362, v 178-191 (could also be a hat ornament or the top of something carried). On the t7|t8 boundary: keep one if t7 has him. Foot est from the head and a ~95 px figure height. Merge: t7's back-row man S3.fig.man_dark_cap_back_row_19325 (head (19325, 193)) stands 25 px west; both kept, one man or two for the second pass (merge crops gen/map/S3/look/merge_crown_backrow*.jpg). SECOND PASS (east): one man or two with t7's back-row man? Two. On zoom-2, zoom-6 and saturated colour crops, t7's man (19313-19337) has his own face under a low dark cap (v 193-217). This man's tall peaked hat with its slanting stick (19336-19362, v 185-211) is a separate shape east of it. The hat sits straight above the round face of S3.fig.deck_rail_face_19350 (19337-19356, v 223-243), with a dark band (hair) between (v 211-223). As that man's own hat it would make one head about 58 px tall, against about 20 px for the faces round it, so a separate man in the second row is the better reading, his face hidden behind the front man's head. Keep both (no change). Crops: p2e_c_backrow.jpg, p2e_c_backrow_z2.jpg, p2e_c_backrow_z6.jpg, p2e_c_backrow_col.jpg.

entities.name: man in a big round hat bending over the railing
entities.what: Man bending far forward over the railing, his head covered by a large round wide-brimmed hat with a dark crown, looking straight down at the boat; his arms hang over the rail.
entities.support: bridge deck: 150 px west of the near edge
entities.vis: part: face and body hidden by the hat brim and the railing
entities.note: On the deck at the railing. The large ellipse (19378-19430, v 202-247) with a dark top at (19411-19425, 202-212) is read as a wide hat seen from above with its crown; other reading: a large round basket held up by a man whose capped head is at (19413, 203). Either way one figure stands here.

entities.name: pale bundle hanging over the railing
entities.what: A pale rounded object with vertical folds hanging over the outside of the near railing just below the wide-hat man's hands: a bundle or basket being lowered toward the boat, or a cloth hung on the rail.
entities.support: bridge deck: 150 px west of the near edge
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Object 19378-19406, v 258-307 (its bottom reaches below the deck edge). Base est at the railing's foot above it. Could also be the wide-hat man's sleeves and hands (then drop it). If it hangs on a rope to the boat, river_e names it as that rope's far end.

entities.name: youth leaning over the railing with a line in his hand

entities.note: On the deck at the railing. Head 19430-19449, v 221-245; arm to about (19470, 255). Painted head 15-20 px smaller than the men's: a youth, or a man stooping lower. The line is river_e's (part of its boat), its near end in his hand.

entities.name: small dark animal at the bridge's north end

entities.vis: faded
entities.note: Body 19783-19833, v 167-195; legs to v 203-210; head raised at 19830-19847, v 160-177. SCALE: body ~50 px long and ~35 px from hooves to back, against ~75 px for the cart man beside it (about 1.1 m long, 0.8 m high): donkey-sized, but faint enough to be a dog. Just north of the bridge's north ramp: on the north bank, or on the far side of the ramp's deck if the bridge agent's deck_n line runs north of v 205 here. Merge: joined to t9's S3.grp.handcart_19862 by place (it stands just west of the cart's puller; t9 and the bridge agent read the two together); no tack is painted, so it walks with the cart rather than drawing it (t9: no animal draws the cart). The bridge agent's "a man and a small dark animal" there are this animal and t9's puller S3.fig.cart_puller_19870 (merge crop gen/map/S3/look/merge_north_dog.jpg).
